chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Mas'ada ibn Sadaqa, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

That the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) used to ride the mule of the Messenger of Allah, then he would pass by the fish market and say: 'Indeed, do not eat and do not sell what does not have a shell/scales.'

key_terms.بَغْلَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: The mule of the Messenger of Allah
key_terms.قِشْرٌ: Shell or scales (referring to the outer covering of fish)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating fish without scales according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi highlights Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) practical application of the 'scales' criterion for seafood, a foundational principle in Shia fiqh distinguishing permissible fish from other sea creatures. By delivering this ruling while riding the Prophet’s mule in the fish market, the hadith underscores the continuity of prophetic authority and the immediacy of judicial guidance in public commercial spaces. This incident is frequently cited by scholars to validate the exclusion of shellfish and crustaceans from the category of 'fish' in Shia dietary law.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from haroun Bin Muslim, from Mas’ada Bin Sadaqa,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> was riding a mule of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>. Then he<sup>asws</sup> passed by a fish market, so he<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘Indeed! Neither eat nor pursue what does not happen to have scales on it!’
en.sarwar: 9. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated [from his father] from Harun ibn Muslim from Mas’adah ibn Sadaqah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has stated this Hadith.

’Amir al-Mu’minin would ride the mule of the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause. He (the Imam) then would pass by the fish market and say, ‘You must not use for food and must not sell whatever does not have scales.’”
